## Refactor Safety

- [ ] Meaningful phase/chunk is isolated in its own commit.
- [ ] Legacy compatibility impact is stated when old paths or APIs change.
- [ ] Rollback path is clear for runtime-affecting changes.
- [ ] New package boundaries obey the dependency rule.
